# cubepath_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain name for the zone.

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) The project ID. Uses default project if not specified.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the zone was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the DNS zone.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Assigned nameservers for the zone.
- `records_count` (Number) Number of DNS records in the zone.
- `status` (String) The status of the DNS zone.
